was: Recommended by Grok as one of the best campgrounds in Maine.  Some campsites appear to be lakefront.  --AWH  The Sebago shore is day-use beaches (Witch Cove, Naples Beach) and the sites are set back in pine forest behind them; no campsite frontage, lake views pine-screened. Big sandy beaches for day use; 92 sites have E/W hookups. --Claude
